'''Crimson Fang''' gang was a little known criminal organization operating in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], the Crimson Fang, led by [[Elarea Aldraste]] known as "The Red Huntress", took over [[Port Nowhere]] by force, planning to use the mobile space station as their base of operations. The Alliance sent a strike team on a [[Battle of Port Nowhere|mission]] to liberate Port Nowhere, which systematically rid the station of Outer Rim's most notorious villains.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Crimson Fang gang appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Crimson Fang" Uprising.
